lesson.title: Comparing fractions
lesson.summary: Which of two fractions is bigger
lesson.content:
## Same bottom

With the same denominator, the bigger numerator is the bigger fraction: 3/5 > 2/5.

## Different bottoms

Rewrite both with a common denominator first: 1/2 = 3/6 and 1/3 = 2/6, so 1/2 > 1/3.

## Check

Compare the decimals: 0.5 > 0.33.

vocabulary.meaning: a bottom number both fractions can share
vocabulary.example: 6 is a common denominator of 1/2 and 1/3.
vocabulary.example_meaning: both can be written in sixths

quiz.prompt: Which is bigger, 3/5 or 2/5? Give it as a decimal.
What is a common denominator of 1/2 and 1/3?
